title: Model pinning lifecycle and publishable performance guarantees for model variants
creator: Ayesha Khan
description: Define and ship a reproducible lifecycle and publishing pipeline for Redwood-verified performance guarantees (latency / throughput / cost) tied to specific model versions and variants. This ticket captures the PM scope: 1) pin semantics and metadata, 2) minimum benchmark methodology and sample sizing, 3) Console publishing UX and API surfaces for pinning to profiles, and 4) automated revalidation triggers and rollback guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Model manifest includes immutable version pin fields and a human-readable variant tag that maps to published performance profile. 2) Performance profile schema (latency P50,P95,P99, throughput, cost per million tokens) is defined and stored in the catalog. 3) Console exposes a publish flow that shows required validation checks and allows pinning a model version to a profile. 4) CI/CD pipeline automatically re-runs benchmarks when runtime changes or when a pinned model is updated, and flags regressions with an actionable rollback button in Console.
progress_updates: 2025-02-17: Initial scoping meeting with Eng (Liam, Priya), Runtime (Marco), and Observability (Tessa). Agreed on goals and minimal viable schema.

2025-02-21: Drafted performance profile schema and sample-size guidance. Decided to require N>=30 warm-run sequences for latency P95 stability for hosted benchmark. Trade-off: longer runs increase cost but reduce noise for public guarantees.

2025-02-25: Eng wants to delay P99 in first iteration (unstable with smaller samples); we'll publish P50/P95 + throughput + cost and add P99 in next iteration. Updated acceptance criteria accordingly.
2025-03-01: Console mockups reviewed by Design; UX flows approved with one change — surface 'validation history' for each published profile. Assigned DES-2134 for UI refinement.
2025-03-02: Created runtime PR to add benchmark hooks and manifest parsing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987
review_feedback: From Marco (Runtime): Need explicit kernel/config fingerprint in profile to know when invalidation is required. Proposed adding a "kernel_hash" string field. (Action: Eng to add to schema.)
From Tessa (Observability): Add sampling distribution example and guidance for tails — include guidance to run synthetic high-latency cold start tests.
From Legal (Sanika): Avoid customer-facing claims about 'guaranteed' latency without SLA; update language to 'verified under Redwood test conditions'.
qa_plan: 1) Run verification harness for three representative models (small, medium, long-context) with the published profile and compare reported P50/P95 to Console display. 2) Inject a kernel change in staging to confirm profile invalidation and re-run pipeline. 3) Regression test: pin/unpin flow, publish history, rollback button triggers fallback policy. 4) Cross-check cost numbers against billing simulation for 1M tokens.
next_steps: ENG: Add kernel_hash and manifest pinning fields to runtime schema (ENG-4124).
PM: Finalize human-readable language for Console copy per Legal feedback.
Design: Update mockups to include validation history and 'verified under test conditions' badge (DES-2134).
Observability: Add dashboard card for published profile comparisons and alert on regression thresholds.
Ops: Create a low-cost sandbox that can run nightly benchmark jobs for pinned models.
